text.description_html:
RK International CP-43, Fancy 3 Inch Clear Acrylic Cabinet Door Pull

The twists of the acrylic in this cabinet handle really catch the light in a beautiful way. Pulls like this one are often used in bathrooms where the clear acrylic has a water-like appearance, twisting between the two mounts like a crystal waterfall; but it would look just as nice in the kitchen or as a pull on a small piece of furniture. The Twisted Clear Acrylic 3 Inch Cabinet Pull is available with 4 different accent finish choices: satin nickel, polished chrome, polished brass, and oil rubbed bronze.

Specifications and Features of the RK International CP-43 3" Traditional Acrylic Cabinet Pulls:

  • Material: clear acrylic with brass mounts
  • Acrylic Color: Clear
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Overall Length: 3-5/8"
  • Width: 5/8"
  • Projection: 1-1/8"
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Sold Individually
